4591.questionText: Why do you think more and more people prefer to travel by plane?
4591.expression: the choice starts to make itself
4591.example: With only two days off, the choice starts to make itself.
4591.meaningAndReason: One option becomes so attractive that deciding feels automatic; a personification.

4648.questionText: What are the positive impacts of tourism in your country?
4648.meaningAndReason: Allows firms to continue operating; a life metaphor.

dispositions.reason: “The choice starts to make itself” is intelligible personification of an increasingly obvious decision, but the exact source states only a two-day time limit and never states the alternatives or the criteria that make one option clear. Existing owner 4511 teaches a default option and owner 1604 teaches a compromise; neither is same-sense. An exploratory seven-step target would repeatedly infer unstated alternatives and hinge on a weakly bounded self-making formula. No owner or new lesson is asserted from this evidence alone.

Keep + a business/shop/store/café + alive is a natural, reusable economic-survival collocation. The lesson teaches demonstrated support for continued operation, distinct from owner 526’s engine of business activity/progress, owner 484’s failure-causing sink metaphor, and keep-history/relationship-alive referents. Source asserts weekend tourism sustains businesses; the learner scenarios supply their own evidence of essential bills being covered. Survival is not treated as profit growth.

positives: Small orders keep the shop alive.
Membership dues keep the business alive.
Weekly market orders kept the store alive.
Orders are keeping the café alive.
negatives: The engine keeps the business moving.

sevenStepDecisions.listening: attribute continued operation to weekend visitor demand rather than mere popularity
sevenStepDecisions.reply: four individually valid partner responses explain time-limited paid support and its expiry; only golden uses target
sevenStepDecisions.scene: bank-transfer orders let one grocer operate despite a card-network outage, without implying the whole market recovered
sevenStepDecisions.contrast: public attention without customers or sales is insufficient evidence of survival
sevenStepDecisions.dialogue: paid school sessions sustain a commercial studio this term; renewal remains uncertain
sevenStepDecisions.speaking: bakery preorders are a counterfactual bridge through roadworks
sevenStepDecisions.writing: time-limited repair vouchers bring paid customers to a shoe-repair shop; both models state the June endpoint and unknown replacement trade

findingsAddressed.R4648-01: Distinct attribution, time limit, payment workaround, evidence, renewal, counterfactual and voucher-transfer decisions replace repeated cost-versus-expansion cases.
findingsAddressed.R4648-02: All four partner replies now state the current paid-booking support and its limited term.
findingsAddressed.R4648-03: Dialogue now names an explicitly commercial recording studio; target business referent is natural.
findingsAddressed.R4648-04: Both writing models state that voucher support ends in June and no replacement trade is secured.
